digest.component_or_area: outbound parent reconciliation (CREATE emit, ACLI attach fallback)
propositions: CREATE emit at adapters/jira/outbound_fields._map_local_to_jira_fields:145-156 drops a non-epic parent with only logger.debug, leaving no durable bridge_alerts record
ACLI create-then-attach fallback at adapters/jira/acli_cli_ops._attach_parent_guarded:136-143 swallows HTTP 400 parent rejection and returns success without calling record_parent_divergence
Bound non-epic parent suppressions must be reported to dropped_field_sink with (local_id, 'parent') tuples for CREATE mutations, while unbound parents must remain silent to avoid churn
The epic-only parent guard is unconditional in both Cloud and Data Center code but for different reasons: Cloud rejects with HTTP 400; DC accepts and silently ignores
UPDATE emit path (slot 1) already records parent drops durably via dropped_field_sink and outbound-field-dropped alerts; CREATE emit and ACLI attach paths remain unreliable
